english.title: Enter / remain operational parts / trespass on land near to the Tyne and Wear Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or reasonable excuse

(A)_[entered or remained in operational parts of the Tyne and Wear Metro]_
(B)_[trespassed on land, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..), in dangerous proximity to the Tyne and Wear Metro]_

in contravention of a No Trespass notice displayed at the nearest station
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 29 and 31(1) of the Tyne and Wear Metro Byelaws made under sections 58 and 62 of the Tyneside Metropolitan Railway Act 1973.

english.notes:
(i) Byelaw 30 make provisions in relation to name and addresses.
(ii) Byelaw 31(2) provides powers for the removal of persons.
(iii) Byelaw 31(3) provides that when using these powers, an authorised person, including a constable, must show his/her identification if requested.
(iv) Byelaw 31(6) provides that in relation to this byelaw: An authorised person acting in the course of his duties shall not be liable for breach of this byelaw.
(v) Byelaw 31(4) provides that no person shall be subject to any penalty for breach of any of the Byelaws by disobeying a notice unless it is proved to the satisfaction of the Court before whom the complaint is laid that the notice referred to in the particular Byelaw was displayed.
